div.div:
Measured
• Deployed: p50 271 ms · p95 591 ms · p99 889 ms · 58 req/s · 0 errors · 20 readers through CloudFront, 1 API task (0.25 vCPU).
• Local: p95 189 ms at 20 readers after caching the parsed JWT key (first run 947 ms: key re-parsed per request, 27 ms CPU each).
• Lesson recorded: the bottleneck was CPU in auth, not SQL; profiling before adding caches avoided an unnecessary replica.
